structure_policy_rationale: Original图标为写实人物肖像（亚瑟），包含复杂的光影、皮肤纹理和面部细节。根据theme_design_analysis中关于复杂IP的处理规则（参考honor_of_kings和lol_mobile案例），必须舍弃写实人像，转而提取‘红蓝对抗’的核心语义进行几何化重构。保留人脸轮廓会导致风格不伦不类且违反扁平化规则，因此判定为semantic_recompose。
preserve: 红与蓝的高饱和度对立配色关系
代表对抗或能量的抽象几何符号形态（如漩涡、太极、闪电、交织线条）
MOBA游戏的竞技对抗感视觉隐喻
5v5团队作战的对称或双元素并置构图
must_preserve: 红蓝主色调的强烈对比
极简的几何化主体形态
无立体光影的平面化处理
recompose_allowed: 将写实人物完全替换为抽象几何徽章
使用红蓝色块拼接表现对抗概念
引入简单的装饰性几何图形（如星星、圆点）
调整主体形状为圆形、盾形或对称图形
restyle: 去除所有金属质感、渐变和高光
将边缘处理为不规则、抖动的手绘痕迹
填充方式改为哑光平涂色块
线条模拟马克笔或蜡笔的粗糙触感
decorate: 在色块内部添加简单的手绘纹理或颗粒感
保持主体居中，四周留黑均匀
forbid: 禁止出现任何写实的人脸、五官或肢体
禁止使用金色、银色、白色以外的金属渐变色
禁止保留原图的复杂背景纹理或场景
禁止使用细线条、平滑矢量边缘或完美对称
禁止使用主题色板（红/蓝/黄/白/黑）之外的颜色
禁止添加阴影、投影或环境光遮蔽
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle style icon for a MOBA game. Pure black background. Central subject is an abstract geometric badge composed of solid saturated red and blue blocks, representing opposing forces (like a stylized yin-yang or clashing shields). Thick, rough, uneven black marker-pen outlines. Flat colors, no gradients, no shadows, no realistic details. Naive, clumsy, cute aesthetic. High contrast.
color_application: Map the original 'Red vs Blue' faction colors to the theme's high-saturation brick red and deep royal blue. Use solid flat fills only. No gold or metallic gradients; if yellow is needed for contrast, use the theme's warm yellow/milky white sparingly as an accent.
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular, hand-drawn black outlines to all geometric shapes. Edges must appear rough and shaky, simulating a dry marker or crayon on paper. No smooth vector lines.
composition_application: Center the abstract geometric symbol on the pure black canvas. Occupy 50-70% of the area. Ensure balanced visual weight between red and blue elements to imply '5v5' symmetry or confrontation. Keep surrounding space pure black.
identity_application: Express identity through the semantic concept of 'confrontation' using red/blue color duality and dynamic geometric arrangement, rather than literal character representation. The abstract shape should evoke a battle emblem or shield clash.
fidelity_constraints: Must use thick, rough hand-drawn black strokes
Colors must be limited to high-saturation red, blue, yellow/white
No gradients, shadows, or 3D effects allowed
Subject must be flat geometric blocks
negative_constraints: No realistic faces, eyes, or human features
